label: Distinct esse has another actual cause of being, from being caused and no self-causation
meaning: Non-transcription conditional derivation, for the same witness and the same q.3 a.4 profile: every actual x whose esse differs from its essence has its esse caused by another being that is in act as to being. This is the exact passage from 'not self-caused' to 'caused by another': the only extra premise beyond no-self-causation and the actuality of causes of being is that every actual distinct esse has some cause of being. The conclusion certifies a distinct (c distinct from x, not non-constituent) cause of being in the DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION sense that is in act as to being; the q.3 a.4 statement's 'efficiently' is its prose reading, not an extra condition of the type. Sibling support option for STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE beside the q.3 a.4 transcription af503cd7; it shares that route's underlying commitment to causal coverage of distinct esse, so it is not independent corroboration of it. The cause is tenseless (CausesIn c x esse): no conservation, present sustaining, world-indexed existence, concreteness, uniqueness or God identification follows. A real distinction is the input DistinctEsseAt; no argument for it is used.
